prompt: Bug: the default value of a boolean option that has both a positive and a negated form depends on the order the two options are added. With `program.option('--no-pepper').option('--pepper')` and no arguments, `program.opts().pepper` is `true`, but with `program.option('--pepper').option('--no-pepper')` it is `undefined`. Order must not matter. Only a lone negated option (`--no-foo` without a matching `--foo`) should get the implicit default of `true`; when both forms are defined there is no implicit default, and an explicit default given to the negated option (for example `.option('--pepper').option('--no-pepper', 'remove pepper', 'plain')`) must be used. Fix this in the library and add tests. The existing test suite must keep passing.
